_comment: PEEK-Bench extraction target = the 9 FFF process parameters of Figure 1 + UTS. Column names mirror PEEK2-CF-main-2026May17-CF-P27d.xlsx (Sheet1). GT is PRE-imputation: blank means the paper does not report it, and null is the correct answer. The 'NOT ...' clauses are the real competing wordings found by scanning all 23 source papers (549 distractor terms); infill<-extrusion-flow and specimen<-layer thickness are confirmed observed failures.

columns.name: cf_paper_id
columns.note: given in the prompt; copy verbatim

columns.name: sample_id
columns.note: the paper's own run/sample label where one exists

columns.name: nozzle_diameter
columns.note: orifice bore, 0.2-1.0. NOT filament dia 1.75, NOT bead/road width, NOT fibre dia in um

columns.name: nozzle_temp
columns.note: extruder setpoint. NOT drying/annealing T, NOT melt Tm or Tg, NOT printer max, NOT grade digits (450G)

columns.name: printing_speed
columns.note: print-head deposition speed. NOT tensile crosshead rate in mm/min, NOT screw rpm. If the paper gives mm/min, do the arithmetic yourself and write ONLY the resulting number (never an expression like 20/60)

columns.name: fiber_weight_fraction
columns.note: carbon-fibre wt% of THIS row's material, 0-30; 0 for neat PEEK. NOT vol%, NOT infill %, NOT crystallinity %. Do not infer from grade digits (K10)

columns.name: raster_angle
columns.note: in-plane deposition angle as TEXT: '+-45', '0', '90', '0/90'. NOT build orientation, NOT contact or fracture angle. Pattern name only ('Lines') -> null

columns.name: infill_percentage
columns.note: slicer infill density of the part interior. NOT extrusion flow %, NOT porosity/void %, NOT crystallinity %, NOT elongation %, NOT ANOVA contribution %. null if no infill setting is stated

columns.name: specimen_thickness
columns.note: thickness of the tensile coupon, typ 2-4. NOT layer height, NOT wall/shell thickness, NOT test-fixture span. Do not infer from the test standard

columns.name: layer_thickness
columns.note: slice/layer height, typ 0.1-0.4. NOT bead width, NOT nozzle diameter, NOT specimen thickness

columns.name: platform_temp
columns.note: heated bed setpoint. NOT chamber/ambient/enclosure T, NOT drying oven, NOT annealing T

columns.name: tensile_strength
columns.note: measured ULTIMATE tensile stress, mean. NOT yield, NOT flexural/compressive, NOT modulus (thousands of MPa), NOT peak load in N, NOT datasheet or FEM-predicted values
